sources.entry: Inkdrop - Notebook app for Markdown lovers built on top of Electron.

summary.name: Inkdrop
summary.one_liner: Inkdrop is an AI-native Markdown note app for developers, with encrypted sync, an MCP server for AI agents, and apps across desktop and mobile platforms.
use_cases: let AI agents like Claude Code read and search your notes
write and organize developer tech notes
capture ideas on mobile and desktop
automate note workflows via scripts or local HTTP API
summary.what_it_does: Inkdrop is a Markdown note app aimed at developers. It offers an MCP server so Claude Code or other MCP clients can search and read notes, and AI-ready templates that carry instructions for agents to fill in. Notes sync end-to-end encrypted and work offline. The editor supports slash commands, a floating formatting toolbar, code-aware autocompletion, emoji shortcuts, and inline AI editing and next-edit suggestions. Rendering covers syntax-highlighted code, Mermaid diagrams, and KaTeX math. Organization uses nestable notebooks, tags, pinning, and note statuses, and it is customizable through a Telescope command palette, selector-based keymaps, Vim keybindings, a TypeScript plugin API, init.js, styles.css, and a local HTTP server.
notable: MCP server lets AI agents like Claude Code search and read your notes
End-to-end encrypted sync that works out of the box, including offline access
Telescope command palette, selector-based keymaps, and a TypeScript plugin API
Built on Electron according to the awesome-mac listing
caveats: Single Basic plan after a 30-day free trial; charged once the trial ends
Pricing details beyond the trial and the listed Basic plan (30GB storage, cloud sync) are not stated on the page
